requirements: Measurements uses the Analysis date filters: 1m, 3m, 6m, All, and Custom.
Training balance uses the selected volume, set, rep, or duration metric and date range.
New performed sets capture a nullable logging timestamp. Old and imported sets keep unknown times.
Duration groups timed sets by workout date and exercise, subtracts first from last, and sums by category.
Preserve the user's restored workout and measurement data during emulator verification.
